pedals.axis.rudder.name: Rudder
pedals.axis.rudder.note: central rocker arm linking both pedals

unplaced.pedals.axis.brake_left: left (foreground) foot plate; X = left brake not verified
unplaced.pedals.axis.brake_right: right (background) foot plate; Y = right brake not verified

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), pedals seen from the front left at low height; the left pedal is in the foreground, the right pedal behind it (heel rests point to the lower right, toward the pilot)
mappingSource: catalog (read from the user's own pedals: 16D0:0A38 axes RZ, Y, X; rudder = RZ per IL-2 forum https://forum.il2sturmovik.com/topic/90149-mfg-crosswind-rudder-pedals-won%E2%80%99t-work/; X = left / Y = right brake is assumed, not verified)
note: Toe brakes: each whole foot plate tilts about its lower pivot; markers sit on the upper plate. Because the catalog does not know whether X or Y is the left brake, both brake markers are hidden candidates (map=low) until verified on hardware. Left/right was derived from the pedal geometry (heels toward the lower right = pilot side), so the foreground pedal is the left one.
